correctness.rationale: For any purported integer sum, localizing at each head prime p shows that every nonzero head residue must be cancelled by a tail denominator involving p; each tail term can cancel at most two. The dual inequality cancels tail cardinality exactly because 2mu+1/2001=lambda. The standalone integer-only residue DP enumerates all 563 head semiprimes and 168 incident primes and yields an outward-rounded rational upper bound 7767730087/7812500000<1. Additional coarser scales and exact checks of a known 48-term example stress-test boundary conditions.

value.rationale: The least number of distinct squarefree-semiprime unit fractions summing to 1 is a longstanding natural invariant. Watanabe explicitly conjectures the minimum is 47 and constructs 47-term examples, but gives no unconditional unrestricted lower bound approaching it. The elementary harmonic lower bound from the first 37 terms is only 38. The new globally valid bound 41 removes three possible ranks and introduces a reusable prime-local residue dual method whose tail control is independent of any artificial prime-support restriction.
